# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Jul 23, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on July 23, 2026, focused on stabilizing the ElizaOS framework through critical cloud infrastructure hardening, performance optimizations for chat latency, and the promotion of verified staging builds to production. Significant progress was made in unifying intent routing, improving native transcript rendering, and finalizing the MVP workstream for LifeOps and app-control features.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**Cloud Infrastructure & Warm-Pool Hardening**
*   Promoted exact-agent canary controls to production ([#17144](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17144), [#16929](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16929)).
*   Implemented secure warm-pool key handoffs and character pushing at claim time to ensure claimed agents are immediately functional ([#16977](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16977), [#17066](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17066), [#17078](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17078), [#17083](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17083)).
*   Optimized cloud inference admission and billing paths to reduce latency ([#17076](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17076), [#16982](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16982), [#16925](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16925)).

**UI/UX & Intent Routing**
*   Unified structural intent vocabulary and routing for chat, voice, and transcription ([#16510](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16510)).
*   Implemented a typed, append-only transcript-event contract for consistent cross-platform rendering ([#16507](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16507)).
*   Enhanced the home notification shade and wallet balance surface to improve navigation and focus ([#16918](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16918), [#16956](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16956)).

**Core Runtime & LifeOps**
*   Shipped Cloud Notes and Calendar in native apps via `@elizaos/plugin-simple-views` ([#16871](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16871)).
*   Improved planner reliability by matching capabilities rather than hardcoded action names ([#16749](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16749)).
*   Refined LifeOps persona synthesis and scheduling to prevent jargon leakage and ensure privacy ([#16966](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16966)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   **UI/UX:** [#17143](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17143) (Default orange background), [#17048](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17048) (Native chat glass).
*   **CI/Release:** [#17142](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17142) (Categorized auto-notes), [#17080](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17080) (Retire policy ratchets).
*   **Performance/Fixes:** [#17140](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17140) (Streaming telemetry), [#17137](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17137) (Wallet price-coverage), [#17130](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17130) (My Apps mutations).
